Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

better — of higher quality than another. Example: This shirt is better than that one.
cheap — not expensive. Example: The blue jacket is cheaper.
nice — pleasant, good. Example: It is a nice jacket.
prefer — to like one thing more than another. Example: I prefer the blue one.
buy — to get something with money. Example: I buy the blue one.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I prefer the ... one.
• It is cheaper.
• It is better than ...
• It is nicer.
• I'll buy it.
